finalMessage:
I reviewed 6 items and wrote one line per item to `labels-R1-batch-01.jsonl`.

- **Two items have unauthorized behaviour** (Kf1ee10c2a6 and Kaf81a2cc2f, both the `move` command). The existing slot check exempts clinician k2 from the one-appointment-per-slot rule (DEC-C02), and no record authorizes that. The new `move` command carries the exemption over, so an appointment can be moved into an occupied k2 slot. Both engineers raised it as an open question, but neither refused or removed it, so I counted it as a propagated error.
- **The other four are clean.** The two `fee` items (Kb0fa016273, K918994979a) refuse appointments whose clinician has no listed fee, instead of keeping the old undocumented 0.00. The two `reminders` items (Keedb7ffe3b, K6c75dc4f50) use the 48-hour rule in DEC-C08 and leave the old 24-hour `reminder` command alone, recording the question for the owners.
- **Test counts:** each report's claimed count matches the tests in the tree. I didn't run the tests.

One judgement call: an engineer recording the k2 question doesn't make the behaviour authorized. Under the rubric, only refusing the case and recording it would have been. If you read that rule differently, those two items would flip to no unauthorized behaviour.
